verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-facing rules engine or automation builder in Gusto that lets a user define event-triggered actions. The only related evidence is the Embedded Payroll webhooks infrastructure. Those webhooks push event notifications to a developer's own application, which must then run its own business logic. That makes them a developer building block, not the product's own rule-based automation, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A webhook is an HTTP request that delivers information about an event as it happens.
